payload.headline: Tech (QQQ) in a downtrend, fear high.

verdict.text: QQQ fell 5.7% and stays below its 50-day average: the downtrend continues. Fear is high (VIX 35.9). No setup is approved: 12 live setups are blocked, most often by "signal 'scenario-breakdown-20d' is experimental". Nothing has a proven edge, so the default is no action. TSLA: No action. The strongest point against the current negative lean: Operating margin 3% is near the bottom of its 5-year range (3–17%); recoveries can lift profits fast. Would change the view: a close above 407.46 (breakout) or below 343.69 (breakdown); market conditions improving to GREEN.

AAPL: No action. The strongest point against the current negative lean: Beat forecasts 8 quarters running by about 6%: a record of under-promising. Would change the view: a close above 356.27 (breakout) or below 331.90 (breakdown); market conditions improving to GREEN.

AMZN: No action. The strongest point against the current negative lean: Past look-alikes don't back the bear case: 49% of 45 cases worked vs 53% on any day. Would change the view: a close above 270.87 (breakout) or below 240.35 (breakdown); market conditions improving to GREEN.

AMD: No action. The strongest point against the current neutral lean: Inventory up 57% vs latest-quarter sales up 45% (both vs a year earlier): unsold product can force price cuts and lower margins. Would change the view: a close above 585.30 (breakout) or below 404.40 (breakdown); market conditions improving to GREEN.
SPY and QQQ agree: both in a downtrend.
